sql_templates.description: Select stocks that are new highs, VCP or breakouts with strong fundamentals.
sql_templates.sql: WITH RecentPerformance AS (SELECT symbol, close, change_1w_pct, change_1m_pct, relative_strength FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = CURRENT_DATE), VCPPicks AS (SELECT symbol, vcp_score, vcp_breakout_pct FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks WHERE snapshot_date = CURRENT_DATE AND vcp_score > 70), StrongFundamentals AS (SELECT symbol, enhanced_fund_score, market_cap_cat FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = CURRENT_DATE AND enhanced_fund_score > 75) SELECT DISTINCT e.symbol FROM market.equity_eod e INNER JOIN RecentPerformance r ON e.symbol = r.symbol INNER JOIN VCPPicks v ON e.symbol = v.symbol INNER JOIN StrongFundamentals f ON e.symbol = f.symbol WHERE e.trade_date = CURRENT_DATE AND e.close > e.week52_high * 0.95 ORDER BY v.vcp_score DESC, f.enhanced_fund_score DESC;
